State_change_caption: Initially, the bell pepper is presented in its early stages of being chopped, with only a few slices made. Progressing to the second frame, there is a noticeable increase in the number of slices and the presence of other vegetable trimmings, signaling the progression of the meal preparation. By the third frame, the pepper has been fully chopped into smaller dices, and the board is crowded with the evidence of the slicing activity. Throughout these frames, the transformation of the pepper from whole to diced pieces is evident, marking the transition from preparation to the almost-ready inclusion in the cooking process.
